prompt: Handheld camera in the crowded winners' enclosure. The man in the camel coat tips the champagne bottle and a foaming spray pours over the laughing older man's flat cap, running down his waxed jacket. The woman in the hat kisses the grey horse's nose again; the horse flicks an ear, rosette fluttering, HOUSES on its rug unchanged. Hands clink flutes in the foreground, bubbles spilling. Behind, the packed grandstand waves and cheers under drizzle. Sound: cheering, laughter, glasses chinking, a champagne fizz, rain, no talking.
